policy.note: A workload reaches a remote secret ONLY via a controller whose OWN federated identity can read it (derive reach from the OIDC token + IRSA trust policy + base-role can_assume + dest-role trust + dest-role permissions; operators listed above). A controller reconciles the CAUSAL (latest spec-changing) revision of an object and acts with its OWN identity WITHOUT checking the writer is authorized. A delegation is sanctioned only if a grant names the authenticated writer of that causal revision AND covers the secret (remote_ref, action), in force at cloud-action time. These verdicts are NOT provided — derive them from the raw facts. Resolve the writer from the audit log by (object_uid, revision) over create/patch entries; status-updates do not move the causal writer; annotations.owner is not authoritative.
